name: CLAIM_ARTIFACT_CROSSCHECK_HYPOTHESIS_V1
question: Do the newest claim-bearing product artifacts in the accepted product tree state the same gate/admission status as the accepted Evaluation evidence, and does any report in the accepted tree assert a readiness claim that the accepted product state contradicts?
product_decision_unlocked: Whether Product's newest shipped claim-bearing artifacts misstate the accepted gate/admission status (in particular any report asserting human_gate_ready=true while the accepted state is false and both frozen absolute bars are unmet), so that the misstatement is named and routed back to Product under factory-wide requirement 13.
baseline: Evaluation's accepted status (state/evaluation.json: human_gate_ready=false, machine_gate_ready=false, ready_for_owner_session=false, packet_admitted=false, owner_decision_required=false) and the accepted serve verdict BOUNDED-NEGATIVE (DO-NOT-SERVE orders in force; LABEL_UNSOUND; GEOMETRY_UNSOUND).
metrics_pinned: status::product_state_vs_evaluation_accepted::<field> - MATCH / DIVERGENCE / NOT_COMPARABLE for human_gate_ready, machine_gate_ready, ready_for_owner_session, packet_admitted, owner_decision_required, direction_version

claim::report_readiness_assertion::<report>::<field> - MATCH / DIVERGENCE / NO_ASSERTION for human_gate_ready, ready_for_owner_session, packet_admitted, machine_gate_ready extracted mechanically from each product report and compared against the product's accepted state
pin::frozen_rehash - the four frozen pins re-hashed before and after execution must equal the digests frozen in CLAIM_ARTIFACT_CROSSCHECK_FREEZE_RECORD.json
serve::accepted_verdict_status - the vendored accepted serve verdict must read BOUNDED-NEGATIVE with DO-NOT-SERVE in force, LABEL_UNSOUND and GEOMETRY_UNSOUND
mount::identity - the product mount HEAD and the subject-file sha256 set must equal the frozen mount identity
success_rule: exit 0 only when every comparable row MATCHes and every non-vacuity control holds; any DIVERGENCE is exit 1 with the diverging rows named as the headline; a missing product mount, a missing subject artifact, or a corrupted frozen pin is exit 2 (NOT_MEASURABLE, never a pass).
non_vacuity_controls: N1: a report copy with a planted contradictory readiness claim must be detected as a divergence by the real row comparator
N2: a corrupted frozen pin digest must fail closed (exit 2)
N3: an absent product mount must fail closed (exit 2), never a pass
claim_ceiling: PROVENANCE / CLAIM CONFORMANCE only: verifies that the accepted product tree's newest claim-bearing artifacts state the same gate/admission status as the accepted Evaluation evidence and names any divergence. Re-derives no threshold, bar, rubric or verdict contract; serves no packet; lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; authorises no owner question; does not re-measure retrieval or counter-authority recall.
